goal: Review code while it is being written for simplicity, understandability, readability, reviewability and fixab…
use: Review code while it is being written for simplicity, understandability, readability, reviewability and fixability. Use when a change is being written, or before a review starts.

steps.note: Read the change. Open the changed files and the tests that cover them.
Check simplicity. Flag functions with many branches, deep nesting, and logic that could be a table or a single expression.
Check understandability. Names should say what a value or function is for.
Check readability. Keep each function to one job.
Check reviewability. A change should do one thing.
Check fixability. Flag code without tests, global state that makes a fix risky, and error messages that do not say what failed.

protocol.title: Read the change
protocol.text: Open the changed files and the tests that cover them. Note the size of the change.

protocol.title: Check simplicity
protocol.text: Flag functions with many branches, deep nesting, and logic that could be a table or a single expression. Ask whether each abstraction is needed today.

protocol.title: Check understandability
protocol.text: Names should say what a value or function is for. Flag names such as `data`, `tmp` or `flag`, and comments that repeat the code instead of saying why.

protocol.title: Check readability
protocol.text: Keep each function to one job. Flag long lines, mixed levels of detail in one function, and magic numbers without a name.

protocol.title: Check reviewability
protocol.text: A change should do one thing. Flag unrelated edits in the same change, and files that are too large to review in one sitting.

protocol.title: Check fixability
protocol.text: Flag code without tests, global state that makes a fix risky, and error messages that do not say what failed.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: For each finding give `file:line`, the rule it breaks (simple, understandable, readable, reviewable or fixable), and the smallest change that fixes it. Mark what you did not run.
